title: CLAUDE.md
text: n1qn1() (R/n1qn1.R) coerces arguments integer/double, computes nzm = ceiling(n * (n + 13) / 2), picks mode (1 = Hessian, 2 = zm supplied, 3 = restart=TRUE), checks length zm, calls .Call(n1qn1_wrap, ...) (13 args). n1qn1_wrap() (src/RcppExpMod.cpp) validates n/nzm (including n * (n + 1) int overflow guard) allocating, wraps objective/gradient Rcpp::EvalStandard (R function) Rcpp::EvalCompiled (external pointer) src/evaluate.h, passes static callback fwrap() C core. n1qn1_() / n1qn1a_() / majour_() (src/n1qn1_all.c) run BFGS iterations; helpers ajour_, calmaj_, proj_, satur_ live f2c-translated files. return, LDL’ factor zm converted full Hessian H lower triangle c.hess Armadillo. result list value, par, H, c.hess, n.fn, n.gr. assign=TRUE R wrapper stores c.hess environment.
